articles.title: Kraken parent Payward seeks fresh funding at $20 billion valuation ahead of planned IPO
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator is pursuing a new fundraising round as it ramps up acquisitions across derivatives and stablecoins while laying the groundwork for a future public listing.

articles.title: Anchorage is stepping back from Robinhood and Kraken-backed stablecoin group
articles.snippet: Anchorage Digital co-founder and CEO Nathan McCauley said there will be ‘increased neutrality’ from his firm on stablecoins.

articles.title: Banking groups escalate fight over stablecoin yield ahead of Senate vote
articles.snippet: The American Bankers Association amplified warnings the Senate’s Clarity Act could push deposit flight into stablecoins unless lawmakers tighten yield limits.

articles.title: Corpay taps BVNK to bring stablecoin wallets to corporate payments
articles.snippet: Corpay will use stablecoin rails in its treasury operations to improve capital efficiency, reduce reliance on pre-funded accounts, and move funds across its global footprint.

articles.title: Augustus gets conditional OCC approval for AI and stablecoin bank
articles.snippet: Peter Thiel-backed Augustus has won conditional OCC approval for a US bank charter focused on AI-driven payments and stablecoin settlement infrastructure.
